data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a prior year reserve strengthening of USD 156.6 million for its 2019 annual accounts, representing a 5.7% increase relative to the opening gross claims outstanding. While specific causes for this portfolio-wide strengthening are not detailed in the annual accounts, the Directors' Report for the underwriting year accounts mentions adverse development from 2018 hurricanes (Florence, Michael), typhoons (Jebi, Trami), and Californian wildfire losses, which would contribute to prior year movements in the annual accounts. The gross premium mix for 2019 was diversified, with significant contributions from Fire and other damage to property (40.4%), Reinsurance (25.4%), and Third-party liability (14.5%).
raw_causal_phrases: Over/under-provision in respect of prior claims and claim adjustment expenses
Adjustments to the amounts of claims provisions established in prior years are reflected in the annual accounts for the period in which the adjustments are made.

data.data_quality_notes: The claims development triangle on page 17 shows a significant release for prior years, which contradicts the explicit 'Over/under-provision' strengthening figure of 156.605m from the Technical Provisions note on page 15. The explicit provision figure is used as the primary source for prior year development.
